segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on the Northstar deal. They're still at 118 seats, annual, $43,200 net, March 1 go-live. Pricing is fine and procurement said the invoice timing works.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay, good. What's left before we can send the order form?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: The only thing is the data processing addendum. Their counsel sent back one redline on the subprocessors notice period, and our legal team hasn't given me the answer yet.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: How long has that been sitting?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Since last Tuesday. I've nudged legal four times and security twice because legal said they may need security to confirm the notification language. I sent the customer a holding note Friday, and again this morning. The deal is literally stalled until that sign-off comes back, because Northstar won't let procurement release the PO without the approved DPA.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, that's the blocker then. Did they give any indication whether it's acceptable or needs a fallback?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Not yet. The customer's ask is 30 days' notice instead of our standard 15. I don't think it's unusual, but I can't tell them yes without approval.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Right. I'll mention it in the pipeline call as pending legal approval, not a commercial issue. Do they still need the subscription to start March 1?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They do. They have training penciled for March 6 and 7, twelve managers first, then the rest of the seats later that week.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Once the DPA answer comes in, you can send the final order form same day?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. Order form is ready: one-year term, 118 seats, standard support, net 30. I just need that approved language dropped in.
